notes: Starter candidate pool for replacing the paper-facing Group 6 with visually distinct collision pairs.

candidate_pairs.rationale: Canonical cross-species collision where hybridization or dominance is obvious.
Large-animal collision with clear anatomical mismatch.
Farm-animal collision with different head and torso priors.
Striped big-cat collision against a familiar domestic animal.
Predator-prey style collision with distinct forms.
Same family but still visibly distinguishable at object level.
Distinct wool prior versus smooth equine body prior.
Competing footwear concepts where monolithic rendering should support two distinct objects but PoE may collapse category identity.
Closely competing kitchenware concepts that are distinct enough for mono but prone to object-slot collision.
Everyday vessel collision with clear shape and category differences.
